pages.text: A shoulder weapon for Metal Golems, based on the Enchanter's Wand. Place it on a Scribe's Table, make a spell in your spell book, then shift-right click the table with that spell active. The spell must not have a Form glyph: the wand provides Projectile and Accelerate. The golem fires it at its target. Crafted from an Enchanter's Wand.$(br2)Ars Nouveau does not charge golems mana, so casts are limited by a cooldown (and an optional cost cap) in the config. Crafted at an Enchanting Apparatus from the matching diamond golem weapon.
